rule_violations.text: Underlier definition – "unsprinklered locations: any location with 0% sprinklers." vs. Master definition – "unsprinklered locations: any location with no automatic fire protection sprinklers installed."
rule_violations.explanation: The defined term ‘unsprinklered locations’ on the child policy does not exactly match the wording used by the master policy. Consistency of defined terms is required; using '0% sprinklers' instead of 'no automatic fire protection sprinklers installed' constitutes a discrepancy.

rule_violations.text: Underlier – 'Mendoza 1200, C1428 DJG, Buenos Aires, Argentina' vs. Master – 'One Acme Plaza, New Brunswick, New Jersey, United States of America'
rule_violations.explanation: The address information in the child policy is inconsistent with that in the master policy. According to the compliance rules, the address information must be identical across both policies.
